scope: on-demand device-owned key provider and identity signing diagnostic on the existing serialized worker
binding: The runner verifies fresh signed device identity before and after the run and checks role, source, hardware and unchanged boot. Request ID identifies the run.
cancellation: Disconnect requests cancellation without reusing worker memory until synchronous work returns. Partial results never pass.
security: The existing identity store signs one fixed domain-labelled diagnostic message; the signature is verified locally and never returned. Temporary keys and derived bytes are wiped. Separate identity proofs use the established permanent identity signing interface.
qualification: This diagnostic does not perform a peer handshake, adopt traffic keys, qualify clock behavior, radio contention, entropy, or C9 lifecycle acceptance.
